attacks.name: Psionic Blast
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Sap Power|: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender loses 1 |!power| for each |!wild| in the attack roll, and this character gains that amount of |!power|.

attacks.name: Doomsday Chair
steps: |*Whirling Blades|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional |*Doomsday Chair| attack without paying the |!power| cost. The additional attack must target another character within |!range| 2 of the original defender. The additional attack does not have the |*Whirling Blades| special rule.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

superPowers.name: Bow to the Will of M.O.D.O.K.!
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 3. Advance that character |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Imbecile! All the World is a Weapon to M.O.D.O.K.!
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 3 or less within |!range| 3 and Throw it |!range_large|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Pea-Brain! M.O.D.O.K.‘s Genius is Infinite!
superPowers.body: While this character is attacking or defending, during the |*Modify Dice| step of the attack, it may spend any amount of |!power| to use this superpower. For each |!power| spent, this character may reroll 1 of its attack or defense dice. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Psionic Force Field
superPowers.body: When defending against an attack, this character changes |!wild| results in the attack roll to Blanks.
